ATL.note: Key young player injuries. Hard-capped at first apron. Expiring contracts offer trade flexibility.

BOS.note: Tatum returns healthy. Hard-capped at first apron. Draft picks for potential buyer moves.

BKN.note: Significant cap space for 2027 offseason, young core, and draft capital. Porter Jr. extension looms.

CHA.note: Young core with cap flexibility. Injuries provide opportunity for prospect evaluation. Likely sellers.

CHI.note: Star rookie Wilson injured. Embracing tank, likely sellers of veterans for future assets.

CLE.note: High payroll, at second apron. Limited trade flexibility. Core players Mobley, Mitchell, Harden, Allen.

DET.note: Young core, Duren injured. Under tax/aprons with flexibility and picks to be buyers.

DAL.note: Luka Doncic and Anthony Davis lead. Over cap, but under tax/aprons. Flexibility for trades.

DEN.note: Established core with high salaries. Minor injuries to key players. Likely stand-pat at deadline.

GSW.note: Curry injured. High payroll, at first apron. Expiring contracts offer future flexibility.
